text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed an odd bump in p95 for /generate-route after the new routing-policy deploy. p50 unchanged, p95 +~110ms around 18:12 UTC. Canary flagged it.

alex: I saw that too. Live trace suggests lower-priority traffic is experiencing more queue wait. Could be the new preemption windows causing smaller batches.

jin: Quick rollup check:
```
SELECT priority, phase, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, count(*) samples
FROM traces
WHERE endpoint='/generate-route' AND ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY priority, phase
```
High-pri p95 ~78ms (120k samples); low-pri p95 ~400ms (4.3k samples). The 'queue' phase accounts for most of the low-pri p95.

sam: Notably p99 barely moved, so this looks like a cohort mid-tail shift rather than extreme tail noise. Retry/fallback behavior might be triggering for low-pri at high depth.

lia: We do have a fallback that routes to variant-b when queue_depth > 1.2k. Variant-b adds ~95ms compute overhead for some payload shapes. Logs show more variant-b decisions during the window.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: snapshot saved https://redwood.internal/telemetry/snapshots/1771234500

alex: Two practical fixes: (1) show phase-separated percentiles (queue_wait vs service_time) on the route page; (2) show sample_count alongside percentiles and warn when counts are low. Right now the single merged percentile masks phase regressions.

maria: Agreed. Also annotate the dashboard with the routing-policy deploy (PR #3456) timestamp so future triage can correlate.

jin: I'll prototype rollup dimensions: `phase` and `priority`. Example:
```
SELECT phase, priority, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, count(*) samples
FROM telemetry_rollups
WHERE endpoint='/generate-route' AND window='1m'
GROUP BY phase, priority
```
Prelim: p95(queue|low)=330ms, p95(compute|low)=60ms => queue dominates.

sam: Add a sampling-sanity gate too. Some canaries use higher-fidelity sampling which can overrepresent slow debug clients. Flag percentile buckets with samples < 500.

lia: Please add an annotation for the deploy (18:12 UTC) and include a link to the PR in the dashboard notes.

maria: I'll file a small UX ticket: (A) phase split p50/p95/p99 for latency pane, (B) sample_count in legend/tooltips, (C) auto-annotations for config deploys. Who picks up rollup changes?

alex: I'll own wiring the dashboard and the new rollup consumption.

jin: I'll update rollup ingestion to include `priority` and `phase`, and add the low-sample alert.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: created INF-9988 "latency: phase split + sample_count + deploy annotations" and attached a mock image.

sam: UX add-on: in the endpoint breakdown tooltip, show tiny p50/p95/p99 bars split by phase (queue vs compute) for quick triage.

maria: Love that. After changes merge we'll re-run canary gating and see if p95 reverts. If queue wait persists we can tune aging and fallback thresholds. Thanks all.
